scope:
Check extracted SELinux status mmap bounds and permissions with a PFN-map shim.

No real page tables, cache-mode tracking, policy authorization or faults execute.
coverage: 4/8/16 KiB reported pages, zero/mismatched/valid lengths, four offsets, write/maywrite/shared/read/exec flags and remap success/errors. Exactly one owned native page is passed to the mapper on every accepted call; existing controls and errors remain.
limitations: Host shim observes mapping arguments and flag changes only. It does not prove live fault/SIGBUS behavior, status-policy access or leak exploitability.
